notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.1.0-f2 and Thanks!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

Added: 
- Guaranteed way to get the [spoiler]"Blink and You'll Miss It"[/spoiler] Achievement
- Additional interaction with [spoiler]Alex's trash pile[/spoiler]
- Ability to remap Skip Cutscene input

Changed:
- Reduced waiting time of some secrets
- Updated Credits
- [spoiler]Improve skip behavior of Core introduction[/spoiler]

Fixed:
- Various bugs relating to continuity
- Issue preventing remapping scroll wheel down
- [spoiler]Core platforms being inconsistent per save file[/spoiler]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Thank You![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554274/0b3a172e8059fb0eb5616edcfa6e3a1d09e419b7.gif[/img]

Thank you all for playing and enjoying our game. Your support means the world to us and we couldn't have done it without you. Thank you!!!!

notes.title: Animated series ENA gets a video game with the free surreal adventure ENA: Dream BBQ
notes.notes:
I'll admit I'm pretty uncultured apparently as seeing the release of ENA: Dream BBQ today led me down a bit of a rabbit hole about the ENA animated series.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/03/animated-series-ena-gets-a-video-game-with-the-free-surreal-adventure-ena-dream-bbq/

notes.title: ENA: Dream BBQ Launch!
notes.notes:
Chapter 1 of [i]ENA: Dream BBQ[/i] is now available to play, and for free!

We hope you all enjoy what Chapter 1: "Lonely Door" brings to the ENA series. We want to thank our patrons, family, and close friends for their support—all of whom made this game possible.

If you'd like to support the ENA Team and series, please consider buying the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3416090/]Supporter Edition[/url] of the game. This version is not required for experiencing the full gameplay, but it does have an extensive collection of developer insights for what it was (and is) like to create [i]ENA: Dream BBQ[/i]. More importantly: it has dogs!

Thank you for playing our game!
